comments.body: can get from Job Endorsement of Alonso Pincon , he is a spanish npc fleet made of 3 trade carracks that sail from Santiago to somewhere in North of Antilles

comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: I got it from him as he approached the port of Santo Domingo.

comments.author: Elspeth
comments.body: Alonso Pincon goes around Hispaniola (Santo Domingo island) clockwise, from Santiago then up (way up, almost the same height of the little island north of Santiago) and then east to south, finally going down in the strait between Santo Domingo and San Juan.

wiki:
Note: Job Card can also be obtained by using x1 Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers for Receive Endorsement and then receiving it from:

1. Alonso Pincon (Spain; Caribbean - Antilles, Open Sea)
2. Vincent Pincon (Spain; East Coast of Latin America - Cape San Roque, Open Sea)
